questions.q:
Vipul spends 30% of his monthly income on rent, 60% of the remaining on groceries, and 40% of the remaining on others. If he saves ₹ 7056 in a month, then how much (in ₹) does he spend on groceries?

विपुल अपनी मासिक आय का 30% किराए पर, शेष का 60% किराने के सामान पर और शेष का 40% अन्य चीजों पर खर्च करता है। यदि वह एक महीने में 7056 रुपये बचाता है, तो वह किराने के सामान पर कितना (≤ में) खर्च करता है?
questions.s:
Let the total income of Vipul be '100x'

Money spent on Rent = 30% of 100x = 30x

Money spent on groceries =60% of (100x - 30x) =42x

Money spent on other = 40% of (100x- 30x - 42x) = 11.2x

So he saves 100x - 30x - 42x - 11.2x =16.8x

16)8x = 7056

So x=420

So 42x=42*420 = 17640

Option (c) is the correct answer.

x = AB

Population of Country A decreased by p% and B decreased by q% respectively ⇒  A - Ap100 and  B - Bq100
So percentage decrease in x = {AB - A - Ap100B - Bq100} × 100AB
= {AB - 100A - Ap100B - Bq} × 100AB
  =   100AB - ABq - 100AB + ABpB(100B - Bq) × 100AB

questions.q: In an election between A and B, every fifth vote polled was marked as invalid by the machine. In the remaining votes, A wins the election with a margin of 2500 votes or 10% of the total votes polled, over B. If 90% of the invalid votes would have been in favour of B, then which of the following would have been the result of the election?
o:
B would have won by 8%

    B would have won by 3%

    A would have won by 3%    

    A would have won by 8%
B would have won by 8%
B would have won by 8%
questions.s:
Solution

Let total votes polled = 100
Invalid votes = 100 = 20%
Also, A-B = 2500 which is equal to 10% of total votes {given}
So, total votes polled = ×100=25000
Now, if B gets 90% of invalid votes i.e 25000 = 4500 then, difference between A and B = 2500-4500= -2000
i.e B will get 2000 more votes than that of A get
So, B wins by 100 = 8%

जीतने वाले उम्मीदवार को 56% वैध मत मिले, तो हारने वाले उम्मीदवार को = 44%
प्रश्न के अनुसार,
वैध मत का (56 - 44)% = 1458
तो, N ×910×910×12100=1458
⇒N=15,000
अत: मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या= 15,000
Short Tricks :-
मतदाता सूची में मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या = x
फिर प्रश्न के अनुसार ,
x ×910×910×(56-44)100 = 1458
x = 1458×100×10081×12
x = 15,000 मतदाता

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election between A and B, every fifth vote polled was marked as invalid by the machine. In the remaining votes, A wins the election with a margin of 2500 votes or 10% of the total votes polled, over B. If 90% of the invalid votes would have been in favour of B, then which of the following would have been the result of the election?
o_hi:
B would have won by 8%

    B would have won by 3%

    A would have won by 3%    

    A would have won by 8%
B would have won by 8%
B would have won by 8%
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution

Let total votes polled = 100
Invalid votes = 100 = 20%
Also, A-B = 2500 which is equal to 10% of total votes {given}
So, total votes polled = ×100=25000
Now, if B gets 90% of invalid votes i.e 25000 = 4500 then, difference between A and B = 2500-4500= -2000
i.e B will get 2000 more votes than that of A get
So, B wins by 100 = 8%
